statement: After a Silo reseed, an account's total stalk equals the sum of stalk contributions across ALL whitelisted tokens it holds, not just the last-processed token.
formal_expression: s.accts[a].stalk == SUM_over_tokens( stalkIssuedPerBdv[t]*bdv(a,t) + grownStalk(a,t) )
violation_consequence: Accounts holding deposits in >1 token have their stalk overwritten (set, not added) on each token pass; final stalk reflects only the last token reseeded, destroying governance weight and Bean earnings.

statement: Global per-token silo balances (deposited, depositedBdv) equal the sum of all migrated account deposits for that token.
formal_expression: s.sys.silo.balances[t].deposited == SUM_over_accounts(deposit.amount); same for depositedBdv
violation_consequence: In L2ContractMigrationFacet, totalDeposited/totalDepositedBdv are declared but never incremented in the loop, so global balances are overwritten with 0 — corrupting protocol-wide silo accounting (withdrawals, BDV, conversion).

statement: Every L1->L2 migration credit (deposits + stalk) for a given owner can be redeemed at most once.
formal_expression: redeemed[owner] transitions false->true exactly once; replay reverts
violation_consequence: No nonce / spent-marker is stored; the same merkle proof + signature can be replayed to repeatedly add deposits/stalk/roots to reciever, minting unbacked silo balance and governance weight.

statement: ReseedField must terminate and assign each account its plots exactly once.
formal_expression: for each i: inner loop iterates j in [0, plots.length) exactly once
violation_consequence: Inner loop increments `i` instead of `j` (line 49), causing index-out-of-bounds revert (or wrong indexing) — Field reseed cannot complete, bricking the migration of all pods.

statement: The cap on externally-migrated L1 Beans must allow the legitimately-migratable supply to be minted on L2.
formal_expression: EXTERNAL_L1_BEANS >= total external beans eligible for migration
violation_consequence: EXTERNAL_L1_BEANS is hardcoded to 0, so require(0 >= migratedL1Beans) reverts for any amount>0 — external Bean holders who burned on L1 can never receive L2 Beans (permanent fund loss / DoS).

statement: getTokenPrice must return a TWAP when a lookback>0 is requested and an instantaneous price when lookback==0.
formal_expression: lookback>0 => result==TWAP(lookback); lookback==0 => result==spot
violation_consequence: The ternary is inverted: lookback>0 calls getPrice (spot), lookback==0 calls getTwap (which then divides by lookback==0). Manipulation-resistant TWAP requests silently return spot price, and spot requests revert/return 0.

statement: The migration merkle leaf must commit to the L2 reciever so a signature/proof cannot be redirected.
formal_expression: leaf = H(owner, deposits, internalBalances, ownerRoots) AND reciever bound by signature only
violation_consequence: Merkle leaf excludes reciever; only the EIP-712 signature binds reciever. Combined with no replay marker, a leaked/observed signature lets anyone replay deposits to an arbitrary reciever.

statement: Internal balances reseed: sum of per-farmer balances equals declared total and the farmers/balances arrays are equal length.
formal_expression: len(farmers)==len(balances) AND SUM(balances)==totalInternalBalance
violation_consequence: No check that farmers.length==balances.length; mismatched arrays revert (DoS) or, if balances shorter and read defensively, silently truncate. Total guard exists but array-length guard does not.

statement: Migrated grown-stalk uses the correct stem delta and does not underflow when stem == stemTip.
formal_expression: accountStalk += uint96(stemTip - stem) * bdv with stemTip>=stem enforced
violation_consequence: stemTip>=stem is checked; but cast uint96(stemTip-stem) of an int96 difference could mis-handle large/negative-domain stems if stems are negative — needs verification that stem signage is bounded.

statement: Reseed/init functions can only be invoked once, during the diamondCut upgrade, by the contract owner.
formal_expression: ReseedSilo.init / ReseedField.init / ReseedBarn.init callable only via InitDiamond delegatecall by owner
violation_consequence: These init functions are external with no access modifier; if exposed as facet selectors rather than one-shot delegatecalls, anyone could re-run them and overwrite global accounting. Depends on diamondCut wiring.

statement: Only the canonical L1 cross-domain messenger (with xDomainMessageSender == L1 Beanstalk) can trigger L2 Bean mints.
formal_expression: msg.sender==BRIDGE && IL2Messenger(BRIDGE).xDomainMessageSender()==L1BEANSTALK
violation_consequence: If BRIDGE / L1BEANSTALK constants are wrong for the target L2, mints are either impossible (DoS) or, if mis-set, spoofable. Hardcoded addresses must match deployment.

statement: A blueprint (tractor order) cannot be executed more times than its maxNonce.
formal_expression: blueprintNonce[hash] < maxNonce required before each run; incremented after
violation_consequence: If nonce/maxNonce check is missing or off-by-one, an operator can replay a signed blueprint to drain the publisher's allowed actions repeatedly.

statement: The Tractor EIP-712 domain separator must be standards-compliant so signatures cannot be confused with another domain/typed structure.
formal_expression: domainSeparator = H(EIP712Domain typehash, name, version, chainId, this)
violation_consequence: _domainSeparatorV4 uses BLUEPRINT_TYPE_HASH instead of EIP712_TYPE_HASH as the first encoded field. Self-consistent within the contract (sign==verify), so impact is non-standard tooling/wallet display rather than direct fund loss. Low.

statement: Chainlink TWAP loop must not underflow roundId or read across phase boundaries.
formal_expression: roundId-=1 only while a valid prior round exists in the same phaseId
violation_consequence: roundId is decremented by 1 across aggregator phases; Chainlink roundIds encode phaseId in the high bits, so naive -1 can cross into an invalid round, returning 0 (handled) or skewed TWAP.

statement: Total Bean supply minted on L2 during reseed equals the audited L1 Bean supply snapshot (no inflation).
formal_expression: bean.totalSupply() after ReseedBean == beanSupply param == L1 snapshot
violation_consequence: beanSupply, well bean amounts, and unripe supplies are all caller-supplied with no on-chain cross-check; an incorrect or malicious init param mints arbitrary Bean. Trust rests entirely on the upgrade caller.

statement: ReseedBarn fertilizer linked-list (fertFirst/nextFid/fertLast) is well-formed and ascending.
formal_expression: fertilizerIds strictly ascending; nextFid forms a single chain from fertFirst to fertLast
violation_consequence: No check enforces ascending order of fertilizerIds; a mis-ordered input corrupts the nextFid linked list used by Sun fertilizer payout iteration, mispaying or stranding fertilizer.

statement: L1 Beanstalk must be paused and liquidity moved to BCM before any L2 mint can occur (no double-spend across chains).
formal_expression: ReseedL2Migration.init sets paused=true before BeanL2MigrationFacet/burn flow
violation_consequence: If pause ordering or LP transfer fails (e.g. a token transfer returns false but is unchecked), liquidity may remain on L1 while L2 mints proceed, enabling cross-chain double-spend.

statement: mowStatuses.bdv for an account/token equals the sum of that token's deposit BDVs for the account after migration.
formal_expression: s.accts[a].mowStatuses[t].bdv == SUM(deposit.bdv for a,t)
violation_consequence: If totalBdvForAccount is computed but the global deposited totals are wrong (ACC-002), mow/germinate math against global vs per-account bdv diverges, breaking stalk-per-season growth.

statement: USD price inversion (1e24 / price) never divides by zero and preserves 6-decimal precision.
formal_expression: price>0 before 1e24/price; result has 6 decimals
violation_consequence: getTokenPriceFromExternal does 1e24/getTokenPrice(...); if the underlying chainlink call returns 0 (frozen feed) the division reverts instead of the documented graceful 0-return, potentially DoSing peg/minting logic.

statement: Oracle implementation staticcall result decoding reads exactly the returned uint256 price.
formal_expression: mload(data+0x20) == returned price; success checked
violation_consequence: Custom oracle target is read via low-level staticcall + assembly mload without length check; a malicious/short-return oracle implementation can feed an arbitrary price into peg/minting calculations.

statement: Field pods/harvestable/harvested ordering holds: pods >= harvestable >= harvested.
formal_expression: totalPods >= harvestable && harvestable >= harvested
violation_consequence: Checks exist, but only reachable if the loop (STATE-001) terminates; since the loop is broken, these guards are unreachable and field state is never finalized.

statement: activePublisher is reset to address(1) after every tractor execution so no residual delegated context leaks.
formal_expression: post-tractor: activePublisher == address(1)
violation_consequence: If a tractor call reverts after _setPublisher but the reset is not in a finally-equivalent path, a stuck activePublisher could let a later caller act as that publisher. Needs TractorFacet trace.

statement: Pipeline/Farm arbitrary external calls cannot re-enter Beanstalk to mutate silo/field state mid-operation.
formal_expression: no untrusted external call occurs while silo invariants are temporarily false
violation_consequence: Pipeline executes arbitrary user-supplied calls; if invoked while a convert/withdraw leaves balances mid-update and nonReentrant is scoped per-facet only, cross-facet reentrancy could corrupt accounting.

statement: Convert operations preserve BDV: BDV out <= BDV in for non-favorable converts (no stalk minting via convert).
formal_expression: bdvOut <= bdvIn unless converting toward peg per whitelist rules
violation_consequence: Mispriced convert (e.g. via manipulated well reserves during pipelineConvert) could mint BDV/stalk, inflating governance and Bean earnings.

statement: Sum of all account stalk equals s.sys.silo.stalk (total stalk).
formal_expression: SUM(s.accts[a].stalk) == s.sys.silo.stalk
violation_consequence: ReseedSilo never sets the global s.sys.silo.stalk to the sum of issued account stalk (and ACC-001 overwrites per-account stalk), so global vs summed stalk diverge — breaking earned-Bean distribution and governance quorum.

statement: Germinating stalk/roots transitions correctly across the 2-season germination window.
formal_expression: germinating deposits do not earn Bean/vote until fully germinated
violation_consequence: Migrated deposits set stalk directly via reseed; if germination state is not initialized consistently, freshly migrated stalk could vote/earn immediately or be double-counted.

statement: sunrise/season advancement is monotonic and cannot be triggered while paused.
formal_expression: season strictly increases; gated on !paused
violation_consequence: If pause flag interaction with migration leaves season state inconsistent post-reseed, first sunrise on L2 could mint based on stale deltaB.

statement: Flood (sop) distribution does not over-allocate Bean beyond the excess above peg.
formal_expression: sopBeans <= deltaB_excess; per-account share sums to total
violation_consequence: Rounding or share-accumulation error in flood could over-mint Bean to plenty holders, diluting peg.

statement: Only Beanstalk diamond can call Fertilizer.beanstalkMint.
formal_expression: msg.sender == beanstalk (owner) for beanstalkMint
violation_consequence: ReseedBarn deploys the Fertilizer proxy with admin=address(this) (the diamond); if beanstalkMint auth is mis-set, fertilizer can be minted by others.

statement: Dibbler sow: pods issued = beans sown * (1 + temperature/SCALE), with no rounding-up favoring the sower beyond soil.
formal_expression: pods == beans * (1+temp); soil decremented by beans
violation_consequence: Rounding in morning-auction temperature scaling could let a sower mint excess pods or sow beyond available soil.

statement: Well minting deltaB used for sunrise mint equals the manipulation-resistant pump reserves, not spot reserves.
formal_expression: deltaB from cumulative pump TWAP, not instantaneous getReserves
violation_consequence: If deltaB reads instantaneous reserves anywhere in the mint path (cf. ARITH-001 inverted TWAP), sunrise Bean mint can be manipulated by a flash-loan reserve skew.

statement: internalTokenBalanceTotal[token] equals sum of all account internal balances for that token at all times.
formal_expression: s.sys.internalTokenBalanceTotal[t] == SUM(s.accts[a].internalTokenBalance[t])
violation_consequence: Reseed sets total = sum within one token but does not reconcile with possibly pre-existing balances; if state is non-empty pre-reseed, totals drift.

statement: DiamondCut (facet upgrade) requires contract owner.
formal_expression: onlyOwner on diamondCut
violation_consequence: If ownership transfer during reseed leaves owner unset/zero, an attacker could cut in a malicious facet and drain the diamond.

statement: uint128 narrowing of migrated deposit amounts/bdv does not silently truncate values exceeding 2^128.
formal_expression: amount,bdv fit in uint128
violation_consequence: amounts/bdvs are uint128 in the struct; if real balances exceed uint128 they wrap, but Bean amounts are well below 2^128 — low risk.
